import inspect

import solution
from solution import cal_electbill


def test_issue_example_exact():
    """Example assert cal_electbill(75)==246.25."""
    expected = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(75) == expected


def test_issue_example_is_numeric():
    """Example bill 246.25 is a number, not str or None."""
    result = cal_electbill(75)  # input 75 given in issue
    assert isinstance(result, (int, float)) and not isinstance(result, bool)


def test_issue_deterministic_same_input():
    """Same input 75 gives same bill 246.25 on repeat calls."""
    expected = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(75) == expected
    assert cal_electbill(75) == expected


def test_issue_keyword_units():
    """Call as cal_electbill(units=75) gives 246.25."""
    expected = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(units=75) == expected


def test_issue_smaller_units_smaller_bill():
    """Smaller use costs less, so bill for 10 is below 246.25 for 75."""
    bound = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(10) < bound


def test_issue_larger_units_larger_bill():
    """Larger use costs more, so bill for 150 exceeds 246.25 for 75."""
    bound = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(150) > bound


def test_issue_just_below_75():
    """Bill just below 75 is less than 246.25 for 75."""
    bound = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(74) < bound


def test_issue_just_above_75():
    """Bill just above 75 exceeds 246.25 for 75."""
    bound = 246.25  # 246.25 given in issue for 75 units
    assert cal_electbill(76) > bound


def test_contract_signature_single_arg():
    """Public interface is def cal_electbill(units)."""
    assert list(inspect.signature(cal_electbill).parameters) == ["units"]  # ["units"] shown in public interface


def test_contract_returns_number_for_typical_inputs():
    """Function returns a numeric bill for typical integer inputs."""
    for units in [1, 50, 100, 200]:  # typical quantities; only type checked, no guessed bill
        result = cal_electbill(units)
        assert isinstance(result, (int, float)) and not isinstance(result, bool)
